d: After 13 years, two delays and countless internet memes, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally set to arrive on November 19. But the excitement surrounding Rockstar Games’ blockbuster has gone far beyond gaming. Digital pre-orders have reportedly crossed $1 billion, fans are planning parties and some employees are even getting time off to play. In this video, Firstpost explores why GTA 6 has become one of the most anticipated video games ever made. From its return to Vice City and a brand-new storyline to its staggering commercial expectations, the video examines the phenomenon behind the game.…
